source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.7.1, data build 972, released 2026-10-02

data.summary:
Spend 1 CP in any phase, right after you roll any of these for one of your units or models:

- an [Advance](vsdata:core-rule/advance-move), Charge, Damage, [Hazard](vsdata:core-rule/hazard-rolls), [Hit](vsdata:core-rule/hit-rolls), [Save](vsdata:core-rule/save-rolls) or **[Wound roll](vsdata:core-rule/wound-rolls)**
- a roll for how many attacks a weapon gets

Pick that unit or model and roll again. When several dice were thrown, you choose a single die to reroll; **[Charge rolls](vsdata:core-rule/charge-step)** are the exception and get rerolled completely. Like any Stratagem, it can be used only [once in a phase](vsdata:core-rule/using-stratagems).
